name: 55115 · Mahtomedi, MN
findings: ZIP 55115 (Mahtomedi) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55115 (Mahtomedi) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55115 (Mahtomedi) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
